Less rushing.
More passing plates.

Sunday Supper is an imaginary neighborhood gathering with a very simple idea: the best meals are the ones that turn into stories.

Think generous platters, mismatched chairs, and conversations that last long after the last bite. Come as you are. We’ll make room.

A taste of the table

Something
for everyone.

A sample menu inspired by the seasons. Everything is made for sharing, so reach across the table.

Tomatoes, dressed up

To start

Ripe tomatoes, basil, olive oil, a little flaky salt.

The big green salad

On the side

Crunchy leaves, garden herbs, lemony dressing.

Sunday’s red sauce

The main event

Slow-simmered tomato, ribbons of pasta, a snowfall of cheese.

Something sweet

To finish

Olive oil cake, seasonal fruit, plenty of cream.

The menu is a little daydream — this is a fictional concept, not a live restaurant.

The more the merrier

There’s magic in making room.

Our dream table is full of old friends, new faces, and a few extra chairs. Stay for the second helping. Stay for the stories.

The little details
A few little details

Good to
know.

What is Sunday Supper?

A fictional supper club concept celebrating slow meals and the joy of gathering around a table.

Can I book a seat?

This is a design concept rather than a real venue, so there are no reservations just yet.

What’s on the menu?

The sample menu is inspired by simple, seasonal ingredients and dishes that are easy to share.

Can I bring a friend?

In the spirit of Sunday Supper, there is always room for one more.

Until we
eat again.

Make a little room.
Pass a little love.
Keep the good stuff going.
